get.summary: Returns the active plan catalog (Published only).
get.description: Catalog surface for tenant users — returns plans available for purchase (Published status). Draft and Archived plans are excluded. For the admin grid with full lifecycle visibility (Draft / Published / Archived), use GET /plans which requires Plans.Manage.
Returns the full plan details including prices. Published and Archived plans are readable with Plans.Read. Draft plans require Plans.Manage; callers without it receive 404 (no existence leak).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Resource identifier (UUID).

put.description: Only Draft plans can be updated. Published and Archived plans are immutable.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Resource identifier (UUID).

post.summary: Creates a new plan in Draft status.
post.description: Creates a plan in Draft status that can be configured with prices and features before publishing. Draft plans are not yet purchasable. Use the publish endpoint to make the plan available for subscription.

get.summary: Returns a filtered, sorted, and paginated list of Plan entries.
get.description: Executes a dynamic query against Plan using the Granit query engine. Accepts filter expressions, sort directives, column selection, pagination, and free-text search via query parameters. Returns a PagedResult by default. When the groupBy query parameter is specified, returns a GroupedResult instead (same status code, different shape).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page index. Ignored when cursor is supplied.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1-500). Server-side cap applies.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for keyset pagination. When supplied, overrides page.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search across searchable columns declared in the query definition.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated sort directives. Prefix a field with '-' for descending (e.g. '-createdAt,lastName').

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Field to group results by. When set, the response shape becomes GroupedResult instead of PagedResult.

parameters.name: quickFilters
parameters.description: Comma-separated quick-filter names (declared in the query definition).

parameters.name: skipTotalCount
parameters.description: Skip the total row count for faster pagination when the client doesn't need it.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Bracketed filter expressions: 'filter[field.op]=value'. Example: 'filter[name.contains]=alice&filter[age.gt]=18'.

parameters.name: presets
parameters.description: Bracketed preset selectors: 'presets[group]=name'. Applies preset filter groups declared in the query definition.

schema.description: PagedResult when groupBy is absent; GroupedResult otherwise.

post.summary: Publishes a draft plan, making it available for purchase.
post.description: Transitions the plan from Draft to Published. This action is irreversible.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Resource identifier (UUID).

post.description: Archives a published plan, preventing new subscriptions while keeping existing ones active. An archived plan's price history and seat assignments remain valid. This action cannot be undone.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Resource identifier (UUID).

get.summary: Returns query metadata for Plan (columns, filters, sorts, presets).
get.description: Returns the query definition metadata for Plan: available columns with display labels and data types, supported filter operators, default sort order, presets, and quick filters. Use this to dynamically build query UIs without hardcoding column definitions.

post.summary: Creates a new price version for a plan.
post.description: Adds a new price for the given currency and interval. If an active price already exists for the same slot, it is marked as replaced. Allowed on Draft and Published plans. Existing subscribers keep their pinned price (grandfathering).

parameters.name: planId
parameters.description: Subscription plan identifier.

get.summary: Returns the price version history for a plan.
get.description: Returns all price versions for the specified currency and interval, ordered from newest to oldest. Includes replaced prices for audit trail.

parameters.name: planId
parameters.description: Subscription plan identifier.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code (e.g. 'EUR', 'USD').

post.summary: Migrates a subscription to a new price version.
post.description: Updates the pinned price for a specific subscription. Only allowed for Active or Trial subscriptions. Publishes a SubscriptionPriceMigratedEto event.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Resource identifier (UUID).

post.summary: Bulk-migrates subscriptions to a new price version.
post.description: Migrates all active subscriptions on a given plan to a new price version. Optionally filters by old price ID. Returns the number of migrated subscriptions.

get.summary: Returns the active subscription for the current tenant.
get.description: Returns the subscription in Active or Trial status. Returns 404 if no active subscription exists. Requires tenant context.

Returns the full subscription details including plan, seat count, dunning status, and cancellation schedule. Returns 404 if no subscription with that id exists. Requires tenant context or host access.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Resource identifier (UUID).

post.description: Creates a subscription for the current tenant. If trialEndsAt is provided, starts in Trial status; otherwise starts as Active. Requires tenant context.

post.description: Cancels the subscription immediately or at the end of the current billing period depending on the cancelAtPeriodEnd flag. Returns 404 if the subscription does not exist. Returns 409 if the subscription is already cancelled.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Resource identifier (UUID).

post.description: Switches to a different plan. Only allowed for Active or Trial subscriptions.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Resource identifier (UUID).

get.summary: Returns query metadata for Subscription (columns, filters, sorts, presets).
get.description: Returns the query definition metadata for Subscription: available columns with display labels and data types, supported filter operators, default sort order, presets, and quick filters. Use this to dynamically build query UIs without hardcoding column definitions.

get.summary: Returns all seat assignments for a subscription.
get.description: Returns all seat assignments for the specified subscription, including user identifiers and assignment metadata. Returns 404 if the subscription does not exist.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Resource identifier (UUID).

post.summary: Assigns a seat to a user.
post.description: Adds a user to the subscription. Fails if the seat limit is reached.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Resource identifier (UUID).

delete.summary: Revokes a seat from a user.
delete.description: Revokes the seat assignment for the specified user, freeing up a seat slot on the subscription. Returns 404 if the subscription or user seat does not exist.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Resource identifier (UUID).

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: External user identifier from the identity provider.
